recipes.name: Classic Pancakes inspired by Uncle Buck
ingredients: 1/4 cup vegetable oil, plus more for the pan
1/2 tsp vanilla extract (optional) or vanilla paste, doubled
instructions: In one bowl, combine dry ingredients: flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Whisk to combine. - 10 ounces flour - 3 tbsp sugar - 4 tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 1 tsp salt

In another bowl, combine eggs, vegetable oil, and whole milk. Optional: you can also add vanilla extract orpaste here. Whisk to combine. - 2 large eggs - ¼ cup vegetable oil plus more for the pan - 1 ½ cups whole milk - ½ tsp vanilla extract (optional) or vanilla paste doubled
Combine the two bowls and mix together gently with a rubber spatula. The batter should still be lumpy with a few dry streaks of flour. Don’t overmix the pancakes!
Cover the batter and let it rest at room temperature for 10 minutes.
Heat vegetable oil in a nonstick skillet. - 1 tsp vegetable oil plus more for the pan
Ladle one scoop of batter into the skillet and cook for a few minutes. Once bubbles appear on the surface and around the edge of the pancake, cook and flip for a few minutes more.
Stack your pancakes up and serve with syrup and butter if desired. Enjoy! - butter and syrup for serving
